title: Derivation of Optimum Banking Angle on Curved Tracks
assumptions: Zero lateral friction at design speed
starting_principles: Horizontal radial Newton second law F_r = m v^2 / R

ordered_steps.explanation: Resolve normal force N into vertical and horizontal components.
Enforce vertical equilibrium since vertical acceleration is zero.
Equate horizontal normal component to centripetal force and divide equations.

limiting_cases: For flat unbanked track theta = 0, required v_0 = 0 (friction entirely required)
claim_traces: HCV1 Ch 7 p. 115; UP Ch 5 p. 182
